description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event timestamps rather than reconstructed daily inventory.

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Uses current listing state, observed timestamps, or recorded price changes from lean tables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL) AS active,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND deal='sale' AND ppm2>0) AS sale_ppm2,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND deal='rent' AND price>0) AS rent_price,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND deal='sale' AND price>0) AS sale_price,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30) AS recent_exits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30) AS recent_population,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND first_seen >= date_trunc('week', now())) AS current_week,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND first_seen >= date_trunc('week', now()) - INTERVAL '7 days' AND first_seen < date_trunc('week', now())) AS prior_week
  FROM lean.listings
)
SELECT active,
  round(sale_ppm2::numeric,0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
  round(rent_price::numeric,0) AS median_rent,
  round((1200 * rent_price / NULLIF(sale_price,0))::numeric,1) AS gross_yield_pct,
  round(100.0 * recent_exits / NULLIF(recent_population,0),1) AS exit_ratio,
  round((100 * (current_week / NULLIF(prior_week,0) - 1))::numeric,1) AS change_pct
FROM a

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(finished_at) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND is_complete AND finished_at IS NOT NULL))) / 60)::int AS minutes_since_success,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='error' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours') AS failed_24h,
  coalesce(sum(cards) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours'),0) AS cards_24h
FROM lean.scrape_runs

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS day), movements AS (SELECT first_seen AS day, 1 AS new_n, 0 AS closed_n FROM lean.listings UNION ALL SELECT closed_at, 0, 1 FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, COALESCE(sum(m.new_n),0)::int AS new_n, COALESCE(sum(m.closed_n),0)::int AS closed_n FROM days d LEFT JOIN movements m USING(day) GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

panels.title: Closed / estimated active — daily · all categories
panels.description: Uses current listing state, observed timestamps, or recorded price changes from lean tables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flow AS (WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS day), movements AS (SELECT first_seen AS day, 1 AS new_n, 0 AS closed_n FROM lean.listings UNION ALL SELECT closed_at, 0, 1 FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, COALESCE(sum(m.new_n),0)::int AS new_n, COALESCE(sum(m.closed_n),0)::int AS closed_n FROM days d LEFT JOIN movements m USING(day) GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day),
bounds AS (SELECT min(time) AS start_time, min((time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS start_day FROM flow),
seed AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS active FROM lean.listings l CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE l.first_seen <= b.start_time AND (l.closed_at IS NULL OR l.closed_at >= b.start_day)
), changes AS (
  SELECT day, sum(delta) AS delta FROM (
    SELECT (first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date +
      CASE WHEN first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' = date_trunc('day', first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS day,
      count(*)::bigint AS delta
    FROM lean.listings GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT closed_at + 1 AS day, -count(*)::bigint AS delta
    FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
  ) events GROUP BY day
), active AS (
  SELECT f.time, f.closed_n,
    seed.active + sum(CASE WHEN f.time > bounds.start_time THEN coalesce(changes.delta,0) ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (ORDER BY f.time) AS active_n
  FROM flow f CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN seed
  LEFT JOIN changes ON changes.day = (f.time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
)
SELECT time, round(100.0*closed_n/NULLIF(active_n,0),2) AS "closed / observed active %"
FROM active ORDER BY time
